name: gizza-ai/query-result-formatter
summary: Render raw query result rows (JSON/CSV/TSV) into a Markdown or ASCII table

tool.description: Render raw query result rows into a clean, aligned table for docs and chat. data is a JSON array of row objects (columns = the object keys, unioned across rows; missing keys become null_text), a JSON array of arrays, a single JSON row object, CSV, TSV, or a psql/MySQL/SQLite CLI result table (pipe columns with +---+/---+--- rules and a (N rows) footer). input_format=auto (default) sniffs JSON vs a SQL CLI table vs TSV vs CSV. format=markdown (default) emits a GitHub-style pipe table; format=ascii emits a box-drawing grid. header (default true) treats the first CSV/TSV/array row as the header. align is left/right/center. null_text sets how JSON nulls / missing values render (default empty). Runs locally.

align.description: Column text alignment: left (default), right or center.

data.description: The raw query result rows: a JSON array of row objects (or arrays), CSV, or TSV text.

format.description: Output table format: markdown (default, GitHub-style pipe table) or ascii (box-drawing grid).

header.description: For CSV/TSV and JSON arrays-of-arrays, treat the first row as the header (default true); otherwise 'Column N' headers are generated. JSON arrays-of-objects always use the object keys.

input_format.description: Shape of the input: auto (default — sniffs JSON vs SQL-CLI-table vs TSV vs CSV), json, csv, tsv, or sql (a psql/MySQL/SQLite result table pasted from a database shell — pipe columns, +---+/---+--- rules and the (N rows) footer are handled).

null_text.description: Text to render for a JSON null / missing column value (default empty). Set to e.g. 'NULL' to mark database nulls.
